free_tier.stated: Gone. The vendor's own notice states 'Untether AI Corp. has entered into a transaction with AMD. As a result of the transaction, Untether AI will no longer be supplying or supporting our speedAI products and imAIgine Software Development Kit (SDK)... today marks the end of Untether AI's journey.' The company filed for bankruptcy in Ontario on 2025-10-15 with USD 128,630,754 of liabilities against USD 24,958,914 of assets.

notes: Recorded so the next reader does not chase a 2024-era MLPerf inference result into a vendor that has stopped existing. Candidate explanations rejected: (a) the products were spun out to another owner, refuted by the notice saying they will not be supplied or supported; (b) only the data-centre line closed, refuted because the notice names speedAI and imAIgine together. What would reopen it: a LatticeWork-style asset buyer relaunching support for speedAI silicon.
